question: Simplify: (2.4 + 3.125) × 0.25 - (0.75 ÷ 0.3)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Apply the BODMAS rule and use fraction equivalents for faster decimal multiplication. ⇒ (2.4 + 3.125) × 0.25 − (0.75 ÷ 0.3) ⇒ 5.525 × (1/4) − 2.5 ⇒ 1.38125 − 2.5 = −1.11875 **∴ The correct answer is -1.11875.**
